name: Thalanaar
summary: At Feralas's eastern edge, Thalanaar shelters Alliance travelers and watches the road from Thousand Needles. Its hippogryph roost links the mainland with Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Gateway to the Forgotten Wilderness
sections.body: From the east, Thalanaar is the first night elf outpost you meet at Feralas's edge. Here, Thousand Needles' sandstone gives way to forest canopy, with sturdy pavilions and sentinels on watch. Alliance scouts, couriers, and craftsmen find shelter before entering the forest. Beasts, ogres, and Horde forces roam southern Kalimdor, so the outpost is a refuge and a place to gather before venturing in.

sections.title: A Vital Aerial Link
sections.body: Thalanaar's hippogryph master connects Feralas with Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh, Gadgetzan in Tanaris, and Feathermoon Stronghold to the west. These routes cross a region where overland travel is perilous, linking the wilderness to destinations across southern Kalimdor. Craftsmen also come here to seek master leatherworkers, who teach the ancient art of working wild hides beneath the woodland boughs.

faq.answer: At Feralas's eastern entrance beside Thousand Needles, Thalanaar shelters Alliance travelers. The outpost offers basic supplies and flight transport.

faq.q: Where can the flight master send me?
faq.answer: Thalanaar's hippogryph roost connects Feralas with Feathermoon Stronghold off its western coast, Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh, and Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why would crafters seek out Thalanaar?
faq.answer: Caryssia Moonhunter teaches Tribal Leatherworking at Thalanaar to skilled artisans from across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Is Thalanaar safe for Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: No. Night elf sentinels guard Thalanaar as an Alliance settlement and attack Horde members on sight.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you find your first safe haven and a reliable flight hub at Thalanaar. It lies west of the treacherous mesas of Thousand Needles, at Feralas's edge.
As a night elf, you find Thalanaar watching the border and welcoming kin back into Feralas's ancestral shadows beneath its ancient canopy.
